# Bashref 2.0.0

Bashref 2.0.0 is the first integrated software release of the bilingual Bash reference project.

## Installation

Install the official wheel from this release:

```bash
pipx install https://github.com/MMKarii/bash-fa-reference/releases/download/v2.0.0/bashref-2.0.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

Or use the Debian/RPM assets on supported Linux systems.

## Highlights

- offline `bashref` CLI with text and JSON output
- Persian and English lookup/search
- stable exit-code contract
- 97-record bilingual structured Bash reference corpus
- generated Reference Guide and system man pages
- existing 14-chapter Professional Guide
- Bash, Zsh, and Fish completions
- wheel and source distributions
- Debian and RPM packages
- portable, man-page, completion, and documentation archives
- versioned v2.0 website snapshot
- strict tests, packaging smoke tests, docs QA, accessibility, links, anchors, and metadata validation

## Artifacts

Release assets include the wheel, source distribution, DEB, RPM, portable archive, man-page archive, completion archive, documentation archive, Homebrew formula, and `SHA256SUMS`.

## Checksums

Download all required assets and verify:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

## Upgrade from v1

v1.0.0 was a documentation-focused release. v2.0.0 adds the installable CLI, structured reference database, generated manuals, packaging, and release artifacts without removing the historical v1.0 documentation snapshot.
